section.name: Apache Tomcat on IRC
section.p: An IRC channel dedicated to Tomcat exists on Freenode.net.

#tomcat at irc.freenode.net. Click here to begin using freenode in your browser via freenode's webchat server. You'll need to choose a nickname and type #tomcat in the input box labeled 'Channels' before clicking 'Connect' to access the channel.
